$description: The layer every anatomy starts from (ADR-021, CONTRACT-002 Composition step 0). constants: the size-class boundaries, the same in every theme; no design system, theme or brand may set them, because @ux-builder/ui's @media and @container conditions use the same numbers literally (CSS cannot read var() in a query condition). defaults: layout measures a design system may override in its own tokens.

breakpoint-medium.$description: Lower bound of the medium size class (Material 3 window size classes).

breakpoint-expanded.$description: Lower bound of the expanded size class.

breakpoint-large.$description: Lower bound of the large size class.

breakpoint-extra-large.$description: Lower bound of the extra-large size class.

content-form.$description: Maximum width of a form's field column.

content-page.$description: Maximum width of page content in the extra-large class.

target-minimum.$description: Smallest pointer target on any input: 24 CSS px (WCAG 2.2, 2.5.8).

target-touch.$description: Smallest target under pointer: coarse: 44 CSS px (Apple HIG).

diagram-stroke.$description: Outline of a diagram node, and an edge (FEAT-016).

diagram-stroke-strong.$description: The main flow, an action edge, and the accent outline of the project's own parts.

diagram-node.$description: Corner radius of a diagram node; a design system sets its own.
